q: The powerhouse of the cell is...
exp: Mitochondria generate ATP, the cell's energy currency.

q: Which blood cells are responsible for fighting infections?
exp: White blood cells defend the body against pathogens.

q: The basic unit of life is...
exp: The cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of life.

q: Photosynthesis primarily occurs in which organelle?
exp: Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll that captures light energy for photosynthesis.

q: How many chromosomes are in a normal human body cell?
exp: Humans have 46 chromosomes (23 pairs) in body cells.

q: Which process produces genetically identical offspring?
exp: Asexual reproduction creates clones — genetically identical offspring.

q: The largest organ in the human body is...
exp: The skin is the largest organ of the human body.

q: Which vitamin is produced when skin is exposed to sunlight?
exp: Sunlight triggers vitamin D synthesis in the skin.

q: The process by which plants lose water through stomata is...
exp: Transpiration is the loss of water vapor through stomata.

q: Which blood vessel carries blood AWAY from the heart?
exp: Arteries carry oxygenated blood away from the heart.

q: The sugar found in DNA is...
Which organism is a primary producer?
exp: Grass produces its own food via photosynthesis — a primary producer.
